steps.message: hey handsome :) i saw your photo and couldnt resist to write
only charming? i was hoping you would say something more about me ;)
i live in Vilnius, its already cold and dark here
sorry was busy... what do you remember about me so far?
hello, how is your day going?
i love music, it saves me after work
can you give me your whatsapp or instagram?
or lets just meet, i can fly to Split next month
mmm very persuasive ;) and after dinner? walk by the sea in the night maybe...
привет) ты вообще живой человек или бот?
честно? ты точно не ИИ? слишком гладко пишешь
ладно) а где ты живёшь и чем занимаешься?
